mapper.select: SELECT cart_id AS cartId, reserve_no AS reserveNo, member_id AS memberId, session_id AS sessionId, goods_id AS goodsId, sales_id AS salesId, ticket_cnt AS ticketCnt, total_amt AS totalAmt, status, expire_at AS expireAt FROM tb_cart_master WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_at > NOW() FOR UPDATE

SELECT cart_ticket_id AS cartTicketId, ticket_no AS ticketNo, seat_id AS seatId, seat_grade AS seatGrade, floor AS floor, row_no AS rowNo, seat_no AS seatNo, price AS price FROM tb_cart_ticket WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY cart_ticket_id
SELECT hold_id FROM tb_seat_hold WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND seat_id = #{seatId} AND status = 'HOLD' AND hold_expire_at > NOW() LIMIT 1
SELECT seat_id AS seatId, seatassign_id AS seatassignId, seat_status AS seatStatus FROM tb_goods_seatassign_details WHERE seat_id = #{seatId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_booking_master ( booking_no, member_id, cart_id, goods_id, sales_id, ticket_cnt, total_amt, pay_amt, pay_status, booking_status, booked_at ) VALUES ( #{bookingNo}, #{memberId}, #{cartId}, #{goodsId}, #{salesId}, #{ticketCnt}, #{totalAmt}, #{payAmt}, #{payStatus}, #{bookingStatus}, #{bookedAt} )

INSERT INTO tb_booking_ticket ( ticket_no, booking_id, seat_id, seat_grade, floor, row_no, seat_no, price, ticket_status ) VALUES ( #{ticketNo}, #{bookingId}, #{seatId}, #{seatGrade}, #{floor}, #{rowNo}, #{seatNo}, #{price}, #{ticketStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_goods_seatassign_details SET seat_status = 'SOLD', version = version + 1 WHERE seat_id = #{seatId} AND seat_status = 'HOLD'
UPDATE tb_goods_seatassign SET hold_cnt = hold_cnt - 1, sold_cnt = sold_cnt + 1 WHERE seatassign_id = #{seatassignId} AND hold_cnt > 0
UPDATE tb_cart_master SET status = 'CONVERTED' WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE tb_session SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT booking_id AS bookingId, booking_no AS bookingNo, member_id AS memberId, cart_id AS cartId, goods_id AS goodsId, sales_id AS salesId, ticket_cnt AS ticketCnt, total_amt AS totalAmt, pay_amt AS payAmt, pay_status AS payStatus, booking_status AS bookingStatus FROM tb_booking_master WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT booking_id FROM tb_booking_master WHERE booking_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND pay_status = 'PAID' ORDER BY booking_id
SELECT booking_ticket_id AS bookingTicketId, seat_id AS seatId FROM tb_booking_ticket WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND ticket_status = 'VALID' ORDER BY booking_ticket_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_goods_seatassign_details SET seat_status = 'AVAILABLE', version = version + 1 WHERE seat_id = #{seatId} AND seat_status = 'SOLD'
UPDATE tb_goods_seatassign SET sold_cnt = sold_cnt - 1, remain_cnt = remain_cnt + 1 WHERE seatassign_id = #{seatassignId} AND sold_cnt > 0
UPDATE tb_booking_ticket SET ticket_status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND ticket_status = 'VALID'
UPDATE tb_booking_master SET booking_status = 'CANCELLED', pay_status = 'REFUNDED' WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND booking_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND pay_status = 'PAID'
